_doc: Studio-wide text for the Glowfin Games website. Edit, then run: python3 build.py
_languages_doc: First = default, at the site root; others at /<code>/ with text in i18n/<code>.json. countries (CF-IPCountry codes) and accept (browser language prefixes) pick it for new visitors. See AGENTS.md > Languages.
name: Glowfin Games
intro: Glowfin Games is a one-person indie studio in Ireland making small, bright games you can pick up with one hand and keep playing for months.
about: We make games that are quick to learn and give you plenty to work out: clear rules, readable screens, and builds that clever players can push very far.
No ads, no energy timers, no subscriptions. Try it for free, and pay once if you want the rest.

contact.text: Questions, bug reports, press or just saying hi: send us a message.

form._doc: Contact form, shown when both are set. endpoint = the contact Worker URL (worker/contact), turnstile_sitekey = the public Turnstile site key.
